entries.title: Genesis 15:1
segments: Those who are protected by God have no reason to fear, and those who receive his gracious reward will not want any good thing.

entries.title: Genesis 15:2
segments:
Give me; he asks for something higher than the mere increase of his outward estate. 
 
  Steward of my house; or, as many prefer, possessor of my house, that is, heir.

entries.title: Genesis 15:3
segments: Born in my house; a house-servant.

entries.title: Genesis 15:6
segments: Counted it to him for righteousness; accepted him as righteous, through faith, or the exercise of that confidence in God which led him to follow his directions.
That confidence in God which leads men to believe and obey him is counted to them for righteousness and those who exercise it will, for Christ's sake, be justified, sanctified, and saved.

entries.title: Genesis 15:7
segments: Ur of the Chaldees;
Give thee this land; not him personally, but his posterity.

entries.title: Genesis 15:8
segments: Whereby shall I know; by what token or visible sign.

entries.title: Genesis 15:10
segments: One against another; the carcass was divided length-wise, and each half placed opposite the other, with a space wide enough for those who in this way made a covenant, to pass between them in token of its ratification.

entries.title: Genesis 15:11
segments: Fowls; ravenous birds, accustomed to feed upon flesh.

entries.title: Genesis 15:12
segments: Great darkness; emblematical of the affliction which would come upon his posterity in Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 15:13
segments: Four hundred years; the departure of the Israelites from Egypt took place four hundred and thirty years from the time the promise was first made to Abraham; about half of which his posterity spent in Canaan, and the rest in Egypt.

In the present prophecy, uttered some years after the first promise, the round number four hundred is appropriately employed. 
 
God graciously communicates to his people as much knowledge of the future as will best fit them for the discharge of their duty; and what would not be useful to them he kindly withholds.

entries.title: Genesis 15:14
segments:
Judge; visit with judgments, in punishment of their sins. 
 
  Substance; riches.

entries.title: Genesis 15:16
segments:
In the fourth generation; after four hundred years from the time above mentioned; or the fourth generation from the time they went into Egypt, Moses and Caleb being the fourth generation from Levi and Judah. 
 
  Amorites; the Israelites, after they should leave Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 15:17
segments: A smoking furnace, and a burning lamp; symbols of the divine presence.

entries.title: Genesis 15:18
segments: River of Egypt; supposed to be a stream which emptied into the Mediterranean between Gaza and the eastern branch of the Nile.

.  Its present mane is El-Arish. 
 
  Euphrates;
When God in his providence has given to a people a good land, and they abuse his mercies, break his laws, and live in rebellion against him, he may justly take it from them and give it to others.

entries.title: Genesis 15:19
segments:
vv. 19-21 
 
  Kenites--Jebusites; tribes that dwelt in Canaan.
